content.comment_body: I am having trouble with the web server. When I try to change the output value, for example from 1 to 0, nothing happens. Please see the attached file. Thank you!

You can switch a digital output directly from the web server's variable list only if the output is not being used by the program logic. Otherwise, the program will override any changes made through the web server.
I have included screenshots for reference.
If you need to switch outputs that are in use by the program, you can do this from the VM area. Add an OR block before the relevant output and connect an additional network input to this OR block.

analysis.insight_summary: The discussion centers on the challenge of modifying digital output values through the web server interface when those outputs are controlled by the program logic. Changes made via the web server can be overridden if the output is linked to underlying logic. Contributors highlight this restriction and suggest ways to work around it, such as using logic blocks, and note that clearer instructions or more flexible options in the interface would be helpful.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to be able to manually override output values through the web server, regardless of program logic, or to at least receive clear options or notifications when such actions are restricted.
